source.title: Ten Commendation Signets
source.objective:
ProgressI accept commendation signets from outsiders who have received them in the line of duty.  For each set of ten that you hand to me, you will receive significant favor with the Timbermaw.  I also accept single tokens, but for much less favor.  I am much more interested in greater feats of service, though no feat will be ignored.

I'll gladly exchange your signets if you are ready to hand in a set.
source.completion:
Excellent!  You have sacrificed to earn these signets, and and in doing so earned our favor.  Outsiders like you, <name>, can truly make a difference.

Return to me if you have additional signets to hand in; I will exchange them for additional favor.
